about.title: About & Download
about.description: What {brand} is and how to use it; download all HD images and data catalogs; CC BY 4.0 attribution format.
about.lead: 350 layout and composition reference posters—each explaining one layout: what it is, its key points, and when to use it. Organized into {cats} categories and {subs} themes, ready to search, download, and use in your workflow.
about.how1: Click a category tab in the Atlas, or type in the search box on the right to search by name, number, English title, key points, or keywords. Open "Display" to switch to wall or list view and adjust columns per row.
about.how2: Click any card to view it larger, then click the image for actual size so even fine poster text is legible. Layouts with a second version let you toggle between both.
about.how3: Download HD (WebP, 1086 × 1448), or Copy prompt for a concise composition description you can append to your image-generation prompt.
about.how4: Favorite candidate layouts while working on a project, then copy the full shortlist (number + name) in one click under "Favorites" in the Atlas. Favorites are stored only in this browser.
about.zip: All 350 HD images (ZIP): original PNGs via GitHub Release.
about.zip100: Classic 100 Edition (ZIP): the original "100 Layouts" set.
about.data: Data catalog: CSV (opens directly in spreadsheets) · JSON (for scripts & apps). Includes ID, name, category, theme, image path, dimensions, and SHA-256.
about.licenseText: Images and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0: you may share, republish, and adapt them—including for commercial use—with attribution and an indication if changes were made. Suggested attribution:
about.textBody: The Chinese guides on detail pages are rewritten with visual psychology, layout craft, and practical design guidance, alongside the original verbatim text transcribed from each poster for reference. If you spot any errors, please let us know in GitHub Issues.
about.translated: The interface and text in this language were translated from Chinese using AI; the poster images themselves remain in Chinese. If you notice any translation issues, please report them on GitHub Issues.
